_notes: Basic_Model: one PZT -> ideal unity buffer -> ideal ADC. No parasitics, no MUX, all components ideal; the only capacitance is the PZT itself.
The ADC range follows the bias: bias resistor on ground = -VDD/2 .. +VDD/2 (bipolar swing around 0 V), on VMID = 0 .. VDD.

sensor_defaults._note: SM311 = PZT-5H class (Steminc material table: d33 600 pC/N, eps33T/eps0 3500). thickness_mm is an ASSUMPTION (0.25 mm); replace with the real element thickness or measure Cp. Ideal element: no dielectric loss, no insulation leakage.

adc._note: Ideal sampling ADC: the buffer output is sampled instantly every 1/sampling_rate_hz. bits = resolution of the derived ADC-Out value.

single_pulse.description: One 0.1 N force pulse (40 us edges, 250 us hold), bias on ground, 12-bit ADC at 50 kHz, 1 ms run. The bias resistor drains the sensor (time constant R x Cp = 28 us), so the plateau decays and the release undershoots.

bias_vmid.description: Same pulse with the bias resistor on VMID (1.65 V): the output swings around 1.65 V and the ADC range is 0 .. 3.3 V.

sine_1khz.description: Three cycles of a 1 kHz, 0.1 N sine on a ground bias, 20 kHz sampling, 5 ms run.

slow_sampling.description: The single pulse sampled at 5 kHz (200 us period) over 2 ms: the sensor decays by 99.9 % between the conversions, so only the pulse edges are seen.
